notes: Metadata-only snapshot: the 2026-10-22 update shipped a limited mode (Path to Doomsday - Avengers: Endgame), store bundles, and cosmetic/audio fixes.
It contains no hero additions or removals, no role changes, and no Team-Up additions, removals, or re-routes, so roster and Team-Up data are carried over unchanged from 20261009-season-10-5.
Fixes referenced the Punisher -> Daredevil and Hawkeye -> Psylocke Team-Ups (SFX/audio only); both edges were already present.
Team-Up relationships are directional: each active hero has exactly two outgoing partners.
Generated combinations are derived from heroes.json and teamups.json.
